drhp.business: Manufactures and sells branded power transmission equipment under the Bonfiglioli name, part of the Italy-based Bonfiglioli Group. Three revenue verticals: Industry & Automation (gear motors, gearboxes, VFDs, servo drives for factories and process industries), Off-Highway Mobility (hydraulic and mechanical drives for construction, agriculture, and mining equipment), and Wind Industry (yaw and pitch drives for turbines from 225 kW to 5 MW). Products are sold to OEMs and end-users. The Company reports on a calendar year basis (January–December).
drhp.one_liner: Bonfiglioli Transmissions (India) Ltd manufactures power transmission and industrial drive equipment — gear motors, gearboxes, drives, and wind turbine components — from plants in Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra.
risks: We depend on a limited number of suppliers for procurement of raw materials and components required for our manufacturing operations.
Our largest supplier is Bonfiglioli Riduttori S.p.A, a related party.

Purchases from our related parties represented 15.53%, 16.75%, 15.18%, 17.00% and 19.98%, and purchases from our top 10 suppliers represented 40.84%, 41.74%, 41.20%, 45.62% and 47.52% of our total purchases of raw materials and components in the six months periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025 and in Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

As we do not have definitive agreements with our suppliers, any interruption in the availability of raw materials and components on account of any disruption, breakdown or shutdown of our suppliers’ operations could adversely impact our operations.
We depend on a limited number of suppliers for the procurement of raw materials and components required for our manufacturing operations.
We do not typically enter into long-term agreements with suppliers and generally do not have firm commitments from our suppliers.

We instead source raw materials and components on a purchase order basis and negotiate prices and quantities with our suppliers with each purchase order, that set out the rights and obligations of the parties.
We accordingly rely on short-term purchase orders to govern our relationships with our suppliers.

overview.business_model: Manufactures and sells branded power transmission equipment under the Bonfiglioli name, part of the Italy-based Bonfiglioli Group. Three revenue verticals: Industry & Automation (gear motors, gearboxes, VFDs, servo drives for factories and process industries), Off-Highway Mobility (hydraulic and mechanical drives for construction, agriculture, and mining equipment), and Wind Industry (yaw and pitch drives for turbines from 225 kW to 5 MW). Products are sold to OEMs and end-users. The Company reports on a calendar year basis (January–December).
overview.business_overview:
We are one of India’s largest technology-led mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmissions and industrial drive solutions providers by revenue for the six months period ended June 30, 2026 (Source: F&S Report). We manufacture a wide range of mission-critical and highly precision engineered gear motors, gearboxes and drive systems used across diverse end-user markets (Source: F&S Report). Our legacy and reputation lie in the Bonfiglioli brand, which has a worldwide presence of nearly 70 years, and which we have established in India through more than 25 years of operations.

Our Corporate Promoter, Bonfiglioli S.p.A. is headquartered in Italy, and according to the F&S Report, is one of the largest technologically advanced players globally in the mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmissions and industrial drive solutions industry with consolidated revenues of Euro 1,172.94 million (₹115.56 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2025. It focuses on the development, manufacture and distribution of gearboxes and drive systems to cater to the needs of industrial processes, automation, off-highway mobility solutions and renewable energy applications. As at the date of this Red Herring Prospectus, the Bonfiglioli Group has operations spanning across 80 countries through 18 production sites, seven R&D centres, a network of more than 550 distributors and resellers, and a workforce of more than 5,000 employees, with 21 patents granted under the name of Bonfiglioli S.p.A.

(1) Among low and medium-duty gear motors (below 15 kNm) in India based on revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025. (2) Among off-highway mobility market among non-captive players in India by revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025. (3) Among domestic manufacturers of yaw and pitch drives in terms of sales values for the year ended December 31, 2025. (4) We categorize our customers into the relevant business verticals based on application of the customers’ product – for example, mining applications where the equipment is static are categorized under Industry & Automation Solutions while those where the equipment is mobile are categorized under Off-Highway Mobility.

(5) Names of customers identified above have been included based on consents received from such entities to include their names in this Red Herring Prospectus.

Our customer base comprises OEMs that we directly supply products to under our Industry & Automation vertical, and OEMs that we co-engineer with under our Off-Highway Mobility Industry and Wind Industry verticals. We cater to a wide range of industries under our Industry & Automation vertical with no single industry contributing more than 10% of our revenue under the Industry & Automation vertical in the six months periods ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 and in Fiscals 2025, 2024, and 2023. The Industry & Automation vertical benefits from our strong and loyal dealer network which, as of June 30, 2026 comprised of 44 dealers of which 16 dealers had been engaged with us for 20 years or more. Furthermore, of the 44 dealers we engaged with, 36 dealers engaged with us on an exclusive basis as of June 30, 2026. We are an integral part of our customer’s product development cycles under the Off-Highway Mobility and Wind Industries, working closely with them from design stage to create customized, technology intensive products to meet their bespoke end-use specifications. For further information on our customer base, see “ – Our Operations – Sales and Distribution” on page 227.

In the six months period ended June 30, 2026, we served more than 930 customers directly and had been engaged by seven out of our top 10 OEM customers (in terms of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2025) for more than 10 years, demonstrating the lasting value and reliability of our service commitment. We also had a diverse range of customers with our top 10 OEM customers representing less than 31.72% of our revenue from operations in the six months periods ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 and in each of Fiscals 2025, 2024, and 2023. We also engage with dealers for onward sales to OEMs under our Industry & Automation vertical.

(1) Inter-company sales includes sale of finished goods such as yaw drives and swing drives to related parties for onward sale to their customers.

We benefit significantly by being a part of the Bonfiglioli Group, which enables us to leverage its global customer relationships and supply products and solutions to the Indian businesses of international players. With access to the extensive research and development expertise of Bonfiglioli S.p.A. (“BSPA”), including a broad portfolio of innovative products, we are able to meet the localized requirements of our customers. As of June 30, 2026, the Bonfiglioli Group had seven R&D centers globally including in India, Italy, Germany and China, that employed 376 employees. Set forth below is a diagrammatic representation of the holding structure of our Company as on the date of this RHP:

We regularly liaise with the R&D and IT center located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (“India R&D Centre”) which is housed under Bonfiglioli Technology Space Private Limited (“BTSPL”), a company forming part of the

Bonfiglioli Group. The India R&D Centre has test facilities for products across all three of our business verticals, and as of June 30, 2026, it was the only test laboratory in India equipped to test yaw and pitch drives for wind turbines (Source: F&S Report). The proximity of our manufacturing operations with Bonfiglioli Group’s global R&D ecosystem enables faster product development through strong design manufacturing alignment and early supplier involvement, resulting in faster time-to-market and enhancing our responsiveness to India-specific customer requirements, establishing our position as a specialised solutions provider in India. The India R&D Centre is the only R&D centre in the Bonfiglioli Group that caters to all three end-user verticals, which allows us to leverage its development capabilities across our entire portfolio of products and services. For further information on our shared R&D functions, see “ – Our Operations – Research and Development” on page 231. As of June 30, 2026, we operated three facilities in India, two of which were in Tamil Nadu (at Thirumudivakkam and Mannur) and one was in Maharashtra (in Talegaon), that manufactured a combined total of 341,133 units of gear motors and gearboxes in Fiscal 2025. Over the years, we have consistently increased sourcing parts and materials from domestic suppliers to strengthen our localisation strategy. As of June 30, 2026, we had 215 suppliers in India and 70 suppliers outside India. In the six months periods ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 and in Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023, purchases of raw materials and components from the domestic market represented 68.32%, 68.15%, 70.00%, 68.71% and 64.12%, of our total purchase of raw material and components, respectively, demonstrating our commitment to sourcing from India. We source from a diverse network of suppliers, with no single supplier providing more than 20.00% of our purchases in the six months periods ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 and Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023. For further information on our material procurement, see “ – Our Operations – Procurement and Suppliers” on page 237.

We follow a multi-dimensional approach to quality assurance that involves ensuring quality compliance at each level of our operations. We also provide after-sales services to our customers through two dedicated channels: (a) team of in-house service engineers stationed at our 13 sales offices across India (three of which are located at our manufacturing locations in Thirumudivakkam (Tamil Nadu), Mannur (Tamil Nadu), and Talegaon (Maharashtra) that aggregated to 15 engineers as of June 30, 2026; and (b) a broad base of 13 third-party authorised service facilities that had an aggregate of 24 service engineers as of June 30, 2026. We strive to, on average, respond to complaints within the next working day, significantly increasing product uptime and lifecycle value. Our 25 years of operating experience in India, global R&D, manufacturing capabilities, and customer relationships, have enabled us to deliver growth over the years in terms of our profitability, return on equity and return on capital employed.

(3) EBITDA (excluding Other Income) is calculated as profit after tax for the period/ year plus total tax expense plus finance costs plus depreciation and amortization. - We depend on a limited number of suppliers for the procurement of raw materials and components required for our manufacturing operations.
- We do not typically enter into long-term agreements with suppliers and generally do not have firm commitments from our suppliers.
- We instead source raw materials and components on a purchase order basis and negotiate prices and quantities with our suppliers with each purchase order, that set out the rights and obligations of the parties.
- We accordingly rely on short-term purchase orders to govern our relationships with our suppliers.
